human_summary: Independent print-only inspection confirms 120 physical regions across both pages and all twelve systems. The proposed region boundaries, capacities, opening signatures, five key changes and four later clef glyphs match the print. All full-page red crop overlays contain the essential musical ink, including tempo, long slurs, low stems and Allegretto D.C. Geometry-only staff extensions after cautionary signatures in systems 3 and 8 were rejected as extra bars. Every region is explicitly classified; labels must be placed in the report generator’s separate white margins. Only the request and its hashed print/frame and geometry inputs were accessed; no reader outputs, musical candidates or prior reviews were used.
